description: The broad actor grammar needed for Mara must preserve the adventurer's reflexive identity instead of describing SELF as a generic person

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE V-MARA-EAT-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-EAT-REFUSAL>)
          (T <TELL "That is a person, not food." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-DROP-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (T <TELL "You are not carrying that person." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-THROW-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (T <TELL "You cannot throw a person as though they were inventory." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-PUT-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA>
           <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,SANDWICH-BAG> <MARA-SACK-REFUSAL>)
                 (T <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)>)
          (T <TELL "You cannot put a person into an object as though they were inventory." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-MARA-EAT-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-EAT-REFUSAL>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME> <TELL "Eating yourself is not a useful interpretation of that command." CR>)
          (T <TELL "That is a person, not food." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-DROP-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME> <TELL "You are already standing on your own behalf." CR>)
          (T <TELL "You are not carrying that person." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-THROW-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA> <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME> <TELL "You cannot throw yourself as though you were inventory." CR>)
          (T <TELL "You cannot throw a person as though they were inventory." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE V-MARA-PUT-ACTOR ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MARA>
           <COND (<EQUAL? ,PRSI ,SANDWICH-BAG> <MARA-SACK-REFUSAL>)
                 (T <MARA-RELOCATION-REFUSAL>)>)
          (<EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ME>
           <TELL "You cannot put yourself into the " D ,PRSI "." CR>)
          (T <TELL "You cannot put a person into an object as though they were inventory." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>
